channel.title: GiveOwl – 12 Days of Christmas giveaways 2026
channel.description: "12 Days" giveaways are promotions where a sponsor gives away a different prize on each of twelve (or so) days, usually in late November or December. These are the ones from US sponsors we have checked against the official rules. Most treat each day as a separate drawing, so you may need to enter again every day.

item.title: The Filtery 12 Days of Non-Toxic Giveaways – The Filtery
item.description: Prize: 12 daily giveaways from non-toxic brands; grand prize Heavenly Heat ECO Sauna (ARV approx. $5,600). Deadline: November 24, 2026. Sign up for The Filtery newsletter and click the entry button in each day's giveaway email; each giveaway closes 11:59 pm PT the same day. One entry per person per day. Contiguous US, 18+ (grand prize excludes NY and FL). Entering adds you to The Filtery's and the featured brand's email lists

item.title: The Office Depot 12 Days of Giveaways – Office Depot, LLC
item.description: Prize: 12 office-product prize bundles (ARV $399.99–$1,269.97 each), one winner per bundle. Deadline: November 25, 2026. A new giveaway is announced each day Nov 9–20; enter each one once on officedepot.com/l/marketing/giveaways (email, phone, mailing address). All close Nov 25, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. 50 US + DC, age of majority

item.title: Hobby Farms 12 Days of Giveaways – Hobby Farms (EG Media Investments LLC)
item.description: Prize: One prize each day for 12 days (prizes vary by day and are announced on the giveaway page). Deadline: December 12, 2026. Fill in the entry form (name and email) on the Hobby Farms giveaway page, once per day from Dec 1, 2026 12:00 AM ET to Dec 12, 2026 11:30 PM ET. No purchase necessary. Open to legal residents of the 50 US states and DC, 18+. One winner drawn per day from all entries received so far; winners notified by Dec 19, 2026.
